text.heading: Introduction
text.body: As a beginner, I’ve always relied on YouTube tutorials to cook👩🏻‍🍳. But the thing is, no matter how easy a tutorial seems, I always find a way to make it difficult. And perhaps you've experienced the same thing. Recently, our little group made our first batch of Dubai Chewy Cookies to raise funds for a donation. But making the simple dessert proved to be a complicated task.

text.heading: Problem 1 - Black Marshmallows
text.body: We started smoothly by frying the kataifi🍳, mixing in the pistachio paste🥣, and setting it in the fridge🗄️. But then, we arrived at the marshmallow part. For some reason, the marshmallows just wouldn't melt; they clumped together and turned into a charcoal-like dough. I guess that's what we got for using off-looking marshmallows. So, we had to purchase new bags of marshmallows. Luckily, the newly bought ones were melting (as they should), and we added the chocolate powder🍫.

text.heading: Problem 2 - Mushy Pistachio Filling
text.body: Next, we moved on to the pistachio-kataifi filling. We thought cooling it in the fridge would harden it, but after a touch, we knew that was not the case. It was way too mushy to roll into a ball, and we got pistachio-kataifi all over our hands 🙌. After making a huge mess, we finally managed to shape around 28 balls—though a lot of the filling was wasted in the process 😭.

text.heading: Problem 3 - Wonky Shape
text.body: The hardest part, though, had to be wrapping the filling. Our inexperienced hands weren’t prepared to handle the sticky marshmallow skin. We proceeded to make all sorts of wonky shapes🫠. It was looking hopeless until a helper arrived on the scene. My mom came and helped us shape the Dubai Chewy Cookies👩🏻. And her secret ingredient was a bit of oil mixed with the hands. And with that, 25 Dubai Chewy Cookies were packaged and ready to be sold.

text.heading: Problem 4 - Customer Opinions
text.body: Now for the moment of truth... how would they taste? I was worried that the Dubai Chewy Cookies would taste awful😥. I was afraid of how people would react. But what else could I do but pray and hope for the best? The next day, I started selling the Dubai Chewy Cookies. Gaining customers wasn't difficult, however, the crunch time was the taste test🍽️. When I saw them eating, I immediately came and asked, “What’s wrong? Is it bad?” To my surprise (and relief), they just laughed at my overly anxious behaviour and assured me that they tasted great😋.

text.heading: Lesson
text.body: The experience showed me just how different reality can be from my imagination 💭. I was too anxious. We encountered all sorts of problems, but in the end, what was all the fretting for? This taught me to not overthink future events. The process may look chaotic at first, but the result can be surprising. With the chance of failure comes the chance for success. We can only focus on what we can do and pray for the best✨.
